title: Eusebius, Refutation and Defence
english: I read two books of Eusebius's Refutation and Defence, and a second edition of the same, which differs from the first in some passages while agreeing in others.
translator_notes: Pass A≠B for claim photius-bibliotheca-densify; justification reviews/justifications/bibl_codex_13.json

Codex 13 of 279; Eusebius's Refutation and Defence — two books with a second revised edition. Work largely lost; Photius notes the two editions differ in some passages but agree in others.
